seoTitle: Master of Inventory — Home Inventory for Claims
metaDescription: Photograph what you own with prices, receipts, and warranty dates, so an insurance claim or return is one tap away. Private, on-device, iCloud sync.
heroHeadline: Be ready before the claim, not after it
heroSubhead: Photograph, value, and receipt-back everything you own. When a fire, theft, or return hits, the proof is already there — one tap away, not a frantic search through drawers.
highlights: Every item with a photo, price, date, and scanned receipt
Warranty and return deadlines tracked so refunds don't slip away
Stored on-device with Core Data, optional iCloud sync across your devices

features.title: Claim-Ready Records
features.body: Each item carries a photo, purchase price, date, and a scanned receipt — a clear record of what you own and what it's worth when an adjuster asks.

features.title: Warranty & Return Tracking
features.body: Keep warranty expirations and online-return windows next to each item, so you get ahead of deadlines instead of losing money to the ones you forgot.

features.title: Scan In Seconds
features.body: The built-in document scanner makes clean receipt copies. Snap the item, attach the receipt, and the entry is done in under a minute.

features.title: Organized Your Way
features.body: Sort room by room and by your own categories like Electronics or Kitchen. Search and filter your whole catalog instantly.

features.title: Private By Design
features.body: Records live on your device with Apple's Core Data. No third-party servers, no data mining — just your records, yours alone.

features.title: Insurance PDF & CSV
features.body: Export a PDF report with photos, prices, and dates for your insurer, or a CSV spreadsheet for your own files — ready to hand over when it counts.

howItWorks.body: Snap a photo of the item, scan its receipt, and add the price and purchase date.
File it by room and category, and note the warranty or return deadline you care about.
When you need proof, share an item or pull a full PDF or CSV report in a couple of taps.

faq.q: How much does Master of Inventory cost?
faq.a: The app is free and documents up to 50 items. Pro unlocks unlimited items plus PDF and CSV export — $2.99 per month, $19.99 per year (with a one-week free trial), or $39.99 once for lifetime access.
Yes. The yearly Pro subscription includes a one-week free trial, and the free tier lets you document up to 50 items at no cost.

faq.q: Where is my data stored? Is it private?
faq.a: Your records are stored locally on your device with Apple's Core Data. There are no third-party servers and no data mining. Optional iCloud sync keeps your inventory current across your devices using your own iCloud account.
Yes. Capturing items, scanning receipts, and browsing your catalog all work without a connection. iCloud sync catches up the next time you're online.
iPhone and iPad running iOS 14 or later. With iCloud sync enabled, your inventory stays in step across the devices signed into your iCloud account.

faq.q: Can I produce a report for my insurance company?
faq.a: Yes. Pro exports a PDF report with photos, prices, and dates, plus a CSV spreadsheet — ready to hand to an adjuster or keep for your own records.

faq.q: Does it track warranties and return windows?
faq.a: Yes. You can record warranty expirations and online-return windows per item and keep them alongside the item, so deadlines stay in view instead of passing you by.

faq.q: How do refunds work for Pro?
faq.a: Purchases and subscriptions are handled by Apple. Refund requests go through Apple's standard process at reportaproblem.apple.com, and you can manage or cancel a subscription anytime in your App Store settings.

iphone: Add an item with photo and receipt
ipad: Your full catalog on a bigger screen

ctaLine: Five minutes today can save a claim, a refund, and a lot of stress later.
pricingNote: Free for up to 50 items; Pro unlocks unlimited items and PDF/CSV export via subscription ($2.99/mo or $19.99/yr with a one-week free trial) or a one-time $39.99 lifetime purchase.
